violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. In the walk in cooler there are multiple containers of beans that were dated from the 15th that were sitting uncovered.--Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Avocados stored on floor. Food must be stored a minimum of 6 inches off the floor.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Found a wet towel sitting on a prep table in kitchen.

Time as a public health control. — --Food was not served or discarded within four hours from the time when the food was removed from temperature control. Container of peppers and onions on prep line temped at 53F and had been out for more than 4 hours. -Container of peppers and onions should be discarded.

Dispensing equipment - Design and construction. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not properly designed and/or constructed to prevent contamination. Observed a cut down bottle used as an oil funnel in dry storage.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface used with potentially hazardous food was not cleaned every four hours while in use or as frequently as required. Multiple cutting boards on food prep line that were used for raw meats were sitting out from lunch service.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Paper drink cups stored in cardboard box next to coffee maker. Single-service items need to be stored on a hard and durable surface.--Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. To go containers stored open side up. Single-service items need to be stored inverted to protect from contamination.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Multiple ceiling tiles in dry storage are peeling paint.

Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Secondary container of poisonous or toxic material was not clearly identified to indicated contents. Observed two spray bottles of cleaning material that are un-labeled in the dish washing area.

Thawing potentially hazardous food. — --Potentially hazardous food was not thawed in an approved manner. - Oysters were thawing in container of water in sink. Educated manager of proper method of thawing with water. At a water temperature of 21*C (70*F) or below with sufficient water velocity to agitate and float off loose particles in an overflow, for a period of time that does not allow thawed portions of ready-to-eat food to rise above 5*C (41*F).

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. - Container thawing food found in one of the handwashing sinks. Handwashing sinks cannot be used for anything except washing hands.
